title: Sesame Crusted Salmon with Citrus Glaze
description: A dish inspired by Chinese cuisine, this recipe showcases a delicate balance of flavors and textures.
instructions: Line a baking sheet with parchment paper.
Season the salmon fillets with salt and pepper.
In a small bowl, mix together sesame seeds, brown sugar, soy sauce, and rice vinegar.
Place the salmon fillets on the prepared baking sheet and brush the sesame seed mixture evenly over both sides of the fish.
Place the ginger and garlic slices on top of the salmon fillets.
Bake in the preheated oven for 12-15 minutes or until cooked through.
While the salmon is baking, prepare the citrus glaze by mixing together citrus juice and a pinch of salt.
Remove the salmon from the oven and brush with the citrus glaze.
Serve immediately and garnish with sesame seeds and citrus slices if desired.
